mandate.name: Mandate of Heaven
mandate.description: Accrues only from standing structures (each lists mandatePerMin) scaled by base Harmony. Gates tier advancement and charges super-weapons. Lost when structures fall — rushing an unbuilt base yields nothing.

harmony.description: Feng-shui adjacency: structures touching their listed neighbours (or terrain like water) grant bonuses; cramped or isolated layouts fall below 1.0.
